observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 means the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: All eight candidate sets (K8_C0001 through K8_C0008) screen at candidate_k=1, so the partition-level screen shows no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any candidate.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral eigengap at the screened resolution; a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: Leading gaps range from 0.061 (K8_C0008) to 0.156 (K8_C0005), all substantially larger than the next eigengaps (0.0002–0.0027), indicating the single-cluster resolution dominates within each candidate.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions; the dominant gap's location and magnitude are interpreted together.
observations.finding: In every set the largest gap is at k=1, with subsequent gaps one to two orders of magnitude smaller; this profile is consistent with a single dominant cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.0097–0.0104) across all candidates, indicating comparable internal cohesion in the fused geometry.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their between-set affinity; a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries are K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924); these between-set affinities are only slightly below the within-set affinities, identifying these pairs as the most proximate boundaries for possible pair review.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in the structural calculation for each candidate set.
observations.finding: All eight candidate sets have structural calculations covering 7–20 patients, so every candidate is represented in the partition-level screen.

cross_modal_consistency.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and which boundaries are most proximate. The dominant eigengap sits at k=1 for every candidate, with subsequent gaps far smaller, so the screening calculation does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any set; this is triage evidence about internal structure only and does not establish that any candidate is a single biological entity. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006, K8_C0002–K8_C0003, and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 as the closest boundaries, but these are pair-review entry points rather than merge conclusions, and weak pair separation does not recommend merge. No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric was computed here, so this evidence does not directly quantify how well the existing membership or boundary is expressed in native patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied, so this partition-level structural screen stands alone and cannot be corroborated or contradicted by earlier interpreted evidence.
limitations: Partition-level screening provides only candidate_k and eigengap profiles; it does not supply actual feasible k>=2 solutions, child sizes, or split silhouettes, so internal-subdivision feasibility is not evaluated here.
No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric is present, so representation of the current membership or boundary in patient geometry is not directly measured by this result.
Nearest-pair affinities are a review entry point only; they do not establish merge or boundary validity.
Absence of a dominant subdivision signal is not evidence of independence from neighboring candidates, and the screen does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

observations.meaning: How well the already-defined current labels separate in each modality's native distance geometry; no reclustering is performed.
observations.finding: Set-versus-rest separation of K8_C0001 is negligible in CT (0.022) and RNA (0.001), and negative in WSI (-0.067) and WXS (-0.038), indicating essentially no within-set versus between-set distinction in any native modality geometry.

observations.meaning: Mean native distance among same-label versus different-label patient pairs under the current membership comparison.
observations.finding: Only CT shows within-set distances slightly below between-set distances; RNA is essentially equal, and WSI and WXS show within-set distances larger than between-set distances, so the direction of separation is inconsistent across modalities.

observations.meaning: Overall shared structure between two modality patient geometries computed from their native distance matrices; not mechanistic agreement or independent validation.
observations.finding: Global patient-geometry similarity between modality pairs is modest (GRV 0.09-0.20), describing overall shared structure rather than current-boundary support.

observations.meaning: One-sided permutation evidence under exchangeable patient correspondence between the two geometries; not an action threshold.
observations.finding: Global geometry concordance is permutation-significant for ct__wsi, rna__wxs, and wsi__rna, and not significant for ct__rna, ct__wxs, and wsi__wxs; these describe global geometry similarity, not current-label alignment.

observations.meaning: Paired patient bootstrap uncertainty interval and number of nondegenerate replicates for the global geometry concordance.
observations.finding: Bootstrap intervals for global GRV are all above zero with 1000 valid replicates, indicating the global geometry similarity estimates are bounded away from zero, though this concerns global structure rather than current membership.

observations.meaning: Number of patients contributing to the geometry comparison.
observations.finding: The comparison covers 103 patients, so the set-versus-rest alignment for K8_C0001 (13 members) is estimated against a large heterogeneous rest group.

cross_modal_consistency.dimension_interpretation: For K8_C0001, current-label alignment shows essentially no within-set versus between-set distinction in any native modality geometry: silhouettes are near zero in CT and RNA and negative in WSI and WXS, and the within-versus-between distance direction is inconsistent across modalities. This provides limited geometric support for treating K8_C0001 as a separately represented unit relative to the rest of the current partition. The global GRV values describe overall patient-geometry similarity between modalities and are not themselves current-boundary support; the significant global concordances do not translate into current-membership separation. No reclustering was performed, and this evidence does not by itself determine accept or drop.
cross_modal_consistency.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level structural screen reported candidate_k=1 for all candidates including K8_C0001, with a dominant single-cluster eigengap and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal. That screen did not measure current-label alignment or boundary silhouette, so it neither corroborates nor contradicts the present near-zero alignment; together they indicate no internal subdivision signal and little geometric distinction of the current membership. The prior screen's nearest-pair affinities are review entry points only and do not bear on this set-versus-rest alignment.
limitations: Set-versus-rest alignment is interpreted against a potentially heterogeneous rest group comprising the other seven candidate sets, which can attenuate or distort the contrast.

observations.meaning: Computational estimability of the set-versus-rest enrichment analysis.
observations.finding: Enrichment analysis completed successfully for K8_C0001 with 19449 finite ranked genes, so the phenotype comparison is estimable.

observations.meaning: Sample counts for the set-versus-rest contrast; they affect estimability and stability.
observations.finding: The contrast uses 13 set members against 90 rest samples, a modest set size that limits stability of the ranking.

observations.meaning: Normalized enrichment direction and strength relative to the target-versus-rest Wald-statistic ranking, with GSEA multiple-testing-adjusted evidence.
observations.finding: K8_C0001 shows coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, fatty-acid metabolism, adipogenesis, and protein secretion programs, with several pathways reaching small adjusted q-values; the leading-edge genes for OXPHOS are dominated by mitochondrial respiratory-chain and TCA-cycle components.

observations.meaning: Normalized enrichment direction and strength for up-regulated pathways.
observations.finding: Up-regulated programs are weaker and mostly not significant after adjustment (q>0.12), including proliferation-related MYC/E2F and EMT signatures, so the up-side phenotype is less coherent than the down-side.

biological_support.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 exhibits a coherent, interpretable molecular phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by coordinated down-regulation of mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, fatty-acid metabolism, and related metabolic programs, with weaker and largely non-significant up-regulation of proliferative and EMT signatures. This is a biologically interpretable metabolic-low phenotype, but the enrichment is a set-versus-rest association and does not by itself establish that the current membership or boundary deserves independent retention.
biological_support.cross_evidence_context: Prior structural and affinity-geometry reports for K8_C0001 showed no dominant internal subdivision signal and near-zero, modality-inconsistent set-versus-rest geometric alignment. The present RNA phenotype is coherent at the pathway level, which is a different evidence dimension (molecular program rather than patient geometry) and neither corroborates nor contradicts those structural findings.
limitations: The rest group combines the other seven candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
Set size is modest (13 vs 90), limiting stability of the ranked enrichment.
fdr_q values are multiple-testing-adjusted enrichment evidence, not biological importance.
Enrichment is an association with the target-versus-rest Wald-statistic ranking and does not establish causation or clinical meaning.

observations.meaning: Computational estimability of the set-versus-rest mutation enrichment analysis.
observations.finding: Mutation enrichment analysis completed successfully for K8_C0001, so the driver-panel comparison is estimable.

observations.meaning: Sample support in each comparison group and size of the full nonsynonymous interpretation matrix tested.
observations.finding: The contrast uses 13 set members against 90 rest samples across 3583 tested genes, a modest set size that limits stability of per-gene estimates.

observations.meaning: Target-versus-rest mutation enrichment for a prespecified ccRCC driver gene, with BH-FDR within the driver panel (q_driver) and across the full tested-gene family (q_global).
observations.finding: PBRM1 is mutated in all 13 K8_C0001 members versus 26/90 rest samples, a strong enrichment that survives both driver-panel and global multiplicity adjustment.

observations.meaning: Target-versus-rest mutation enrichment for a prespecified ccRCC driver gene, with driver-panel and global multiplicity adjustment.
observations.finding: VHL is mutated in all 13 K8_C0001 members versus 43/90 rest samples; the enrichment is significant within the driver panel but not after global family-wide adjustment.

observations.meaning: Target-versus-rest mutation enrichment for a prespecified ccRCC driver gene, with driver-panel and global multiplicity adjustment.
observations.finding: TSC2 shows a nominal enrichment (2/13 vs 0/90) that does not survive driver-panel or global adjustment.

observations.meaning: Effect estimability; not_estimable_no_events means neither group has a mutation event, so no odds ratio or interval is reported.
observations.finding: CDKN2A has no mutation events in either group, so no effect is estimable; this is neither support nor contradiction.

observations.meaning: Target-versus-rest mutation enrichment or depletion for the remaining prespecified driver genes, with driver-panel multiplicity adjustment.
observations.finding: The remaining driver-panel genes show no adjusted enrichment or depletion in K8_C0001, with wide intervals reflecting sparse events.

value.note: limited display subset; all interpretation-matrix genes participate in q_global

observations.meaning: Limited display subset of non-driver genes; every interpretation-matrix gene participates in q_global.
observations.finding: Exploratory non-driver genes show nominal enrichments (e.g., ATP8A2, SIPA1L3 OR 39.35, p=0.0149) but none survive global family-wide adjustment (q_global=1.0), so they do not establish a coherent non-driver mutational program.

biological_support.dimension_interpretation: For K8_C0001, the WXS driver-panel profile is coherent and interpretable relative to the rest of the partition: near-universal PBRM1 mutation (13/13) with strong, globally adjusted enrichment, and universal VHL mutation (13/13) with driver-panel-significant enrichment. This is a recognizable ccRCC chromatin-remodeling/VHL-associated mutational identity. The remaining driver genes and the exploratory non-driver genes do not add adjusted signal, so the coherent signal is concentrated in PBRM1 and VHL. This characterizes biological identity as a set-versus-rest association and does not by itself establish that the current membership or boundary deserves independent retention.
biological_support.cross_evidence_context: The prior RNA pathway report for K8_C0001 described a coherent metabolic-low phenotype (down-regulated OXPHOS, fatty-acid metabolism, adipogenesis) with weaker up-regulated proliferative/EMT signatures. The present WXS profile is a different evidence dimension (somatic driver mutation rather than expression program) and is concordant in indicating a coherent, interpretable biological identity for K8_C0001; the two dimensions neither corroborate nor contradict each other mechanistically. Prior structural and affinity-geometry reports showed no dominant internal subdivision signal and near-zero, modality-inconsistent set-versus-rest geometric alignment, which concerns patient geometry rather than mutation phenotype.
limitations: The rest group combines the other seven candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
Set size is modest (13 vs 90), and several driver genes have sparse events, producing wide odds-ratio intervals.
q_driver and q_global are multiple-testing-adjusted evidence, not biological importance; q_driver and q_global must not be conflated.
Driver-panel membership is a post-hoc prespecified ccRCC annotation, not a discovery feature-selection criterion.
Exploratory top genes are a limited display subset; the full table is available at artifact_paths.
Mutation enrichment is an association and does not establish causation or clinical meaning.

As a set-versus-rest association it characterizes biological identity but does not by itself establish that the current membership or boundary deserves independent retention.
biological_support.cross_evidence_context: Prior structural reports for K8_C0003 showed no dominant internal subdivision signal and weak, modality-inconsistent set-versus-rest geometric alignment; the K8_C0002-K8_C0003 pair boundary was near zero in fused affinity. The present RNA phenotype is coherent and distinct, which is a different evidence dimension and neither corroborates nor contradicts those structural findings.
limitations: The rest group combines the other seven candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.
Set size is modest (16 vs 87), limiting stability of the ranked enrichment.
fdr_q values are multiple-testing-adjusted enrichment evidence, not biological importance.
Enrichment is an association with the target-versus-rest Wald-statistic ranking and does not establish causation or clinical meaning.

biological_support.dimension_interpretation: For K8_C0003, the WXS driver-panel profile is comparatively weak: no driver gene reaches driver-panel or global significance, with only nominal MTOR enrichment and nominal VHL depletion. The only globally adjusted signal is a non-driver exploratory gene (FLG), which is outside the prespecified ccRCC driver panel and therefore does not by itself define a coherent driver-based identity. Overall the driver-panel mutation profile is less coherent than for K8_C0001 or K8_C0002. This characterizes biological identity as a set-versus-rest association and does not by itself establish that the current membership or boundary deserves independent retention.
biological_support.cross_evidence_context: The prior RNA pathway report for K8_C0003 described a coherent inflammatory-high phenotype (strong up-regulation of TNFA-NFKB, interferon, and UPR programs). The present WXS driver-panel profile is a different evidence dimension and shows little adjusted driver-mutation signal, so the two dimensions are not concordant in strength; the RNA phenotype is the clearer biological identity for K8_C0003. Prior structural reports showed no dominant internal subdivision signal and weak, modality-inconsistent set-versus-rest geometric alignment, and the K8_C0002-K8_C0003 pair boundary was near zero in fused affinity; those concern patient geometry rather than mutation phenotype.
limitations: The rest group combines the other seven candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.

observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 means the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: All eight candidate sets (K8_C0001 through K8_C0008) screen at candidate_k=1, so the partition-level screen shows no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any candidate.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral eigengap at the screened resolution; a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: Leading gaps range from 0.061 (K8_C0008) to 0.156 (K8_C0005), all substantially larger than the next eigengaps (0.0002–0.0027), indicating the single-cluster resolution dominates within each candidate.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions; the dominant gap's location and magnitude are interpreted together.
observations.finding: In every set the largest gap is at k=1, with subsequent gaps one to two orders of magnitude smaller; this profile is consistent with a single dominant cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.0097–0.0104) across all candidates, indicating comparable internal cohesion in the fused geometry.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their between-set affinity; a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries are K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924); these between-set affinities are only slightly below the within-set affinities, identifying these pairs as the most proximate boundaries for possible pair review.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in the structural calculation for each candidate set.
observations.finding: All eight candidate sets have structural calculations covering 7–20 patients, so every candidate is represented in the partition-level screen.

reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and which boundaries are most proximate. The dominant eigengap sits at k=1 for every candidate, with subsequent gaps far smaller, so the screening calculation does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any set; this is triage evidence about internal structure only and does not establish that any candidate is a single biological entity. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006, K8_C0002–K8_C0003, and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 as the closest boundaries, but these are pair-review entry points rather than merge conclusions, and weak pair separation does not recommend merge. No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric was computed here, so this evidence does not directly quantify how well the existing membership or boundary is expressed in native patient geometry.
reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied, so this partition-level structural screen stands alone and cannot be corroborated or contradicted by earlier interpreted evidence.
limitations: Partition-level screening provides only candidate_k and eigengap profiles; it does not supply actual feasible k>=2 solutions, child sizes, or split silhouettes, so internal-subdivision feasibility is not evaluated here.
No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric is present, so representation of the current membership or boundary in patient geometry is not directly measured by this result.
Nearest-pair affinities are a review entry point only; they do not establish merge or boundary validity.
Absence of a dominant subdivision signal is not evidence of independence from neighboring candidates, and the screen does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

observations.meaning: How well the already-defined current labels separate in each modality's native distance geometry; no reclustering is performed.

observations.meaning: Mean native distance among same-label versus different-label patient pairs under the current membership comparison.
observations.finding: Only WXS shows a clear within-set distance below between-set distance; CT and WSI show within-set distances at or above between-set distances, and RNA is essentially equal, so the direction of separation is inconsistent across modalities.

observations.meaning: Overall shared structure between two modality patient geometries computed from their native distance matrices; not mechanistic agreement or independent validation.
observations.finding: Global patient-geometry similarity between modality pairs is modest (GRV 0.09-0.20), describing overall shared structure rather than current-boundary support.

observations.meaning: One-sided permutation evidence under exchangeable patient correspondence between the two geometries; not an action threshold.
observations.finding: Global geometry concordance is permutation-significant for ct__wsi, rna__wxs, and wsi__rna, and not significant for ct__rna, ct__wxs, and wsi__wxs; these describe global geometry similarity, not current-label alignment.

observations.meaning: Paired patient bootstrap uncertainty interval and number of nondegenerate replicates for the global geometry concordance.
observations.finding: Bootstrap intervals for global GRV are all above zero with 1000 valid replicates, indicating the global geometry similarity estimates are bounded away from zero, though this concerns global structure rather than current membership.

observations.meaning: Number of patients contributing to the geometry comparison.

Prior structural reports showed no dominant internal subdivision signal (no feasible k>=2 solutions) and modality-inconsistent set-versus-rest geometric alignment, and the K8_C0004-K8_C0006 and K8_C0006-K8_C0008 pair boundaries were near zero in fused affinity; those concern patient geometry rather than mutation phenotype.
limitations: The rest group combines the other seven candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.

observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 means the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral eigengap at the screened resolution; a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions; the dominant gap's location and magnitude are interpreted together.

reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and which boundaries are most proximate. The dominant eigengap sits at k=1 for every candidate, with subsequent gaps far smaller, so the screening calculation does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any set; this is triage evidence about internal structure only and does not establish that any candidate is a single biological entity. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006, K8_C0002–K8_C0003, and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 as the closest boundaries, but these are pair-review entry points rather than merge conclusions, and weak pair separation does not recommend merge. No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric was computed here, so this evidence does not directly quantify how well the existing membership or boundary is expressed in native patient geometry.

observations.meaning: How well the already-defined current labels separate in each modality's native distance geometry; no reclustering is performed.

observations.meaning: Mean native distance among same-label versus different-label patient pairs under the current membership comparison.

observations.meaning: Overall shared structure between two modality patient geometries computed from their native distance matrices; not mechanistic agreement or independent validation.

observations.meaning: One-sided permutation evidence under exchangeable patient correspondence between the two geometries; not an action threshold.

observations.meaning: Paired patient bootstrap uncertainty interval and number of nondegenerate replicates for the global geometry concordance.

observations.meaning: Number of patients contributing to the geometry comparison.
observations.finding: The comparison covers 103 patients, so the set-versus-rest alignment for K8_C0007 (13 members) is estimated against a large heterogeneous rest group.

observations.meaning: Normalized enrichment direction and strength relative to the target-versus-rest Wald-statistic ranking, with GSEA multiple-testing-adjusted evidence.

As a set-versus-rest association it characterizes biological identity but does not by itself establish that the current membership or boundary deserves independent retention.

observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 means the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: All eight candidate sets (K8_C0001 through K8_C0008) screen at candidate_k=1, so the partition-level screen shows no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any candidate.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral eigengap at the screened resolution; a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: Leading gaps range from 0.061 (K8_C0008) to 0.156 (K8_C0005), all substantially larger than the next eigengaps (0.0002–0.0027), indicating the single-cluster resolution dominates within each candidate.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions; the dominant gap's location and magnitude are interpreted together.
observations.finding: In every set the largest gap is at k=1, with subsequent gaps one to two orders of magnitude smaller; this profile is consistent with a single dominant cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.0097–0.0104) across all candidates, indicating comparable internal cohesion in the fused geometry.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their between-set affinity; a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries are K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924); these between-set affinities are only slightly below the within-set affinities, identifying these pairs as the most proximate boundaries for possible pair review.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in the structural calculation for each candidate set.
observations.finding: All eight candidate sets have structural calculations covering 7–20 patients, so every candidate is represented in the partition-level screen.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and which boundaries are most proximate. The dominant eigengap sits at k=1 for every candidate, with subsequent gaps far smaller, so the screening calculation does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any set; this is triage evidence about internal structure only and does not establish that any candidate is a single biological entity. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006, K8_C0002–K8_C0003, and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 as the closest boundaries, but these are pair-review entry points rather than merge conclusions, and weak pair separation does not recommend merge. No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric was computed here, so this evidence does not directly quantify how well the existing membership or boundary is expressed in native patient geometry.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied, so this partition-level structural screen stands alone and cannot be corroborated or contradicted by earlier interpreted evidence.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and which boundaries are most proximate.
